description: Shared approval preview v1 test vectors (spec F5). Each `screen` is an Agent's visible screen as `herdr agent read --source visible --format text` prints it: captured vectors name their `fixture`, the ANSI capture under Tests/AgenticoTests/ChatFixtures/screens with escape sequences stripped and trailing blanks trimmed; the others are written for the test in the same layouts. `expected` is what the plugin's extractor (src/approval-preview.js) must return, `null` for a screen without numbered options; the values were reviewed by hand against each screen. The Swift tests parse each captured `fixture` with the app's dialog parser and check that the app's prompt binding accepts `expected.q` whenever `expected.act` is true, which keeps the two sides from drifting.
